odc_type: incorrect reference tracking in name analysis
observation_summary: The compiler crashes with an 'IllegalStateException: Unexpected variable' during the VarCheck pass.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurs because the NameAnalyzer fails to properly track references to class-defining functions (like goog.inherits) when the class name is not already known to the system. In the buggy code, the compiler checks if a name exists before adding it to the reference list. If the name is not found, it skips the reference, leading to an incomplete symbol table. Later, the VarCheck pass encounters an undefined variable that should have been tracked, triggering an internal compiler error. The fix ensures that the name is created (by passing 'true' to the getName method) so that the reference is correctly registered, preventing the subsequent crash.
